- Tax: We are a foreign entity; will provide W-8BEN-E for the UK parent and a W-9 for the US subsidiary if needed.
- Remit address: 2120 Harborview Dr, Suite 410, Wilmington, DE 19801 (US subsidiary)
- AP contact: Elena Torres — accounting@umbracosupplies.com | +1 (302) 555-0183
- Preferred invoice reference: please include Redwood PO# in the invoice line; our system accepts PDF invoices and a structured CSV for bulk uploads.

I've attached a signed W-8BEN-E and a sample invoice for your intake team. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires separate vendor records for the UK parent and the US subsidiary, or if we should be onboarded under the US entity only? Also confirm the PO number format Redwood will use so we can map it on our side.

Next steps from our side: we can complete any DocuSign forms and provide bank wiring instructions once the vendor record is created.

Thanks,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Umbraco Supplies — master record intake for Redwood

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick responses below, and I've looped Kimberly from AP to confirm the finance-side requirements.

- Vendor record model: Redwood prefers a single vendor record per legal entity. Because you have both a UK parent and a US subsidiary, we'll need a record for each legal name that will receive invoices/payments. If you intend to receive USD payments via the US subsidiary, we should create the US entity as the primary remit/payee.
- Tax forms: AP will need the W-8BEN-E for the UK parent and W-9 for the US LLC before we route payments.
- PO format: Redwood PO numbers use the format RDW-YYYY-##### (example: RDW-2027-00432). Please ensure your invoicing system maps that PO field to our purchase_order header.
- Invoicing channels: PDF invoices attached to email are fine for low volume. For recurring monthly volumes >25 invoices, we can set up an SFTP/CSV ingest or integrate via the vendor portal.

Kimberly — can you confirm the fields we need on the vendor intake? Also, do we need beneficial owner details for the UK parent for KYC?

Action: I'll provision a temporary vendor record flag so your team can test an invoice match once the payee is created.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0133

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Umbraco Supplies — master record intake for Redwood

Alex — thanks, and great to meet you over email. A few housekeeping items from AP to keep the onboarding smooth:

Required for vendor creation (US subsidiary record):
- Legal name (as registered with state): Umbraco Supplies LLC (exact spelling and punctuation)
- EIN or Tax ID for US entity (W-9)
- Remit address (we have the Wilmington address, please confirm mailing vs. ACH remit)
- Bank wiring instructions (bank name, routing, account, and beneficiary name) — we accept secure upload via the vendor portal or an encrypted PDF via support ticket
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) — Elena Torres listed is fine, please confirm hours of availability for PO/invoice reconciliations
- Authorized signer name and title for invoices >$50k

Required for KYC and vendor master completeness (for foreign parent):
- Parent entity legal name and country of incorporation (Umbraco Supplies LTD, UK)
- Certificate of incorporation or equivalent (pdf)
- Beneficial ownership declaration (UBO) — names and percentage ownership for persons with >25%
- Tax residency confirmation and W-8BEN-E (we received this, thank you)

We will also need a sample invoice showing the PO field (your Sample_Invoice_UMBR-2027-06.pdf is perfect).

Attachments we will upload to your vendor record: vendor_intake_form.pdf (we will send a DocuSign link for signatures on the UBO and payee attestations).

Once we have the documents above, creation timeline is typically 3 business days. If you need faster processing for an initial one-off payment, we can request expedited setup — requires finance approval.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_intake_form.pdf (to be sent via DocuSign)
